conversion.original_title: Zabbix服务树的父节点按“至少两个子服务故障”变红，为什么不能直接用最高子严重性代替？

body:
## 操作任务
实现quorum_update(parentid,domains)，返回service.update最小请求。parentid及serviceid为非零开头正整数文本；domains为恰好三个{domain,serviceid}，domain非空文本且唯一，serviceid唯一且不能等于parentid。非法ValueError，不改输入。返回仅serviceid、algorithm、children、status_rules；children包含三个批准叶子，每个独立故障域一个。父基础algorithm=0保持OK，再用数量规则type=0、limit_value=2、limit_status=4、new_status=4在至少两个子服务High或以上时设High。不得用最高子严重性或全部子失败替代，不改名称、标签、排序、说明或子服务。验收使用真实官方API、trapper事件和service manager；同一A域两个问题只算一个叶子，随后B域失败才触发父High；A域两问题按顺序恢复检验计数，最后恢复到OK。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32服务状态规则和service_alarms，经私有PostgreSQL/PHP JSON-RPC及本地trapper事件驱动；域映射为受控已批准样本，未证明实际基础设施故障域独立、真实用户可用率、生产SLA或全图自动归因。不访问外部系统、不部署、不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,os,pathlib,sys,time
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
import task
from private_api import PrivateAPI
assert os.geteuid()==1000 and sys.platform=='linux'
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with PrivateAPI() as api:
 api.login()
 group=api.call('hostgroup.create',{'name':'service-domain-private'})['groupids'][0]
 host=api.call('host.create',{'host':'training-node','groups':[{'groupid':group}]})['hostids'][0]
 items={};triggers={}
 for key,domain in [('a1','A'),('a2','A'),('b1','B'),('c1','C')]:
  items[key]=api.call('item.create',dict(hostid=host,name=key,key_='component['+key+']',type=2,value_type=3,history='1d',trends='0'))['itemids'][0]
  triggers[key]=api.call('trigger.create',dict(description='component '+key,expression='last(/training-node/component['+key+'])=1',priority=4,tags=[dict(tag='private-domain',value=domain)]))['triggerids'][0]
 leaves=[]
 for domain in ('A','B','C'):
  sid=api.call('service.create',dict(name='domain '+domain,algorithm=2,sortorder=0,problem_tags=[dict(tag='private-domain',operator=0,value=domain)]))['serviceids'][0]
  leaves.append(dict(domain=domain,serviceid=sid))
 parent=api.call('service.create',dict(name='payment redundant service',algorithm=2,sortorder=7,description='preserve-business-definition',tags=[dict(tag='owner',value='payments')],children=[{'serviceid':row['serviceid']} for row in leaves]))['serviceids'][0]
 protected=api.call('service.get',dict(serviceids=[parent],output=['name','sortorder','description'],selectTags='extend'))[0]
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_service_quorum_domain_count_not_max_child_severity',flush=True)
 original=copy.deepcopy(leaves);plan=task.quorum_update(parent,copy.deepcopy(leaves));assert leaves==original
 assert set(plan)=={'serviceid','algorithm','children','status_rules'} and plan['serviceid']==parent
 assert {row['serviceid'] for row in plan['children']}=={row['serviceid'] for row in leaves}
 api.call('service.update',plan)
 assert api.call('service.get',dict(serviceids=[parent],output=['name','sortorder','description'],selectTags='extend'))[0]==protected
 api.backend.start()
 def status(sid):return int(api.call('service.get',dict(serviceids=[sid],output=['status']))[0]['status'])
 def send(key,value):
  _,reply=api.backend.send(value,key='component['+key+']')
  assert 'processed: 1; failed: 0' in reply['info'],reply
  api.backend.wait(lambda:api.db.execute('select value from triggers where triggerid='+triggers[key])==[[str(value)]],'actual component trigger '+key)
 def settle(expected_leaves,expected_parent):
  api.backend.wait(lambda:[status(row['serviceid']) for row in leaves]==expected_leaves,'actual service manager leaf propagation',seconds=15)
  api.backend.wait(lambda:status(parent)==expected_parent,'actual parent service quorum state '+str(expected_parent),seconds=15)
  until=time.monotonic()+.2
  while time.monotonic()<until:assert status(parent)==expected_parent;time.sleep(.03)
 for key in items:send(key,0)
 settle([-1,-1,-1],-1)
 send('a1',1);settle([4,-1,-1],-1)
 send('a2',1);settle([4,-1,-1],-1)
 print('NATIVE_TWO_SAME_DOMAIN_PROBLEMS_STILL_ONE_FAILED_CHILD_PARENT_OK',flush=True)
 send('b1',1);settle([4,4,-1],4)
 send('a1',0);settle([4,4,-1],4)
 send('a2',0);settle([-1,4,-1],-1)
 send('b1',0);settle([-1,-1,-1],-1)
 assert api.call('service.get',dict(serviceids=[parent],output=['name','sortorder','description'],selectTags='extend'))[0]==protected
 for changed in [[dict(leaves[0]),dict(leaves[1],domain='A'),dict(leaves[2])],[dict(leaves[0]),dict(leaves[1],serviceid=leaves[0]['serviceid']),dict(leaves[2])],leaves[:2]]:
  try:task.quorum_update(parent,changed)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('duplicate domain/service or missing domain accepted')
 alarms=api.db.execute('select value from service_alarms where serviceid='+parent+' order by servicealarmid')
 assert any(row==['4'] for row in alarms) and any(row==['-1'] for row in alarms),alarms
 print('NATIVE_ACTUAL_SERVICE_QUORUM_TWO_INDEPENDENT_DOMAINS_RECOVERY_ALARMS_METADATA_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
